responsibility: Defines regression and behavior tests for the symbol interner and identifier helpers in this module, validating stable symbol allocation/reuse semantics and the quote-stripping behavior of `Ident::without_first_quote` under session globals.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is specific to the symbol and identifier subsystem, checking interner reuse/allocation and `Ident::without_first_quote` behavior under session globals. Unlike `lev_distance/tests.rs`, it is about canonical symbol identity and identifier helpers, not fuzzy name comparison or candidate ranking.
